title: He Made $4 Billion Betting on a Crash #shorts
description:
In two thousand seven, hedge fund manager John Paulson bet against the US housing market and pulled off what was called the greatest trade ever.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
hook_text:
$4 BILLION IN ONE YEAR
BETTING ON DISASTER
first_comment: Genius or vulture? Would you have bet against the housing market if you saw it coming? 👇

lines.text: He made four billion dollars in one year, betting on a crash.
But how do you bet against houses?
In two thousand six, America's housing market looked unstoppable.
Hedge fund manager John Paulson saw millions of risky mortgages about to fail.
So he bought insurance against them, called credit default swaps.
It cost him little. Wall Street thought he was crazy.
Then, in two thousand seven, homeowners stopped paying.
The mortgage bonds collapsed. His insurance paid out.
His funds made about fifteen billion dollars.
Four billion went to him alone. The greatest trade ever.
Follow for more fortunes made and lost.
